roadmap.title: Build the first income loop
roadmap.description: Collect popcorn, perform Birb Rebirbs for Golden Feathers and buy Sunflower Vending. Begin Evolution and fishing.

roadmap.title: Build the Nest and companions
roadmap.description: Advance to Evolution III, build the Nest and develop Sparrow and Seagull Rebirbs. Keep popcorn and Seed production running.

roadmap.title: Open Expeditions
roadmap.description: Open Expeditions, improve the Parrot and reach Evolution V to continue past Floor 3. Complete the first Parrot Rebirb and clear Floor 4.

roadmap.title: Expand fishing and mining
roadmap.description: Reach Evolution V for the Aquarium and further Expedition floors. Work on donations, Floors 4–8, Mine challenges and companion progression.

roadmap.title: Finish late-game milestones
roadmap.description: Defeat The Archivist and follow the Evolution VI story. Continue the Mine, Fishdex, shiny collection and large popcorn totals alongside companion Rebirbs.

achievements.summary: Pick up one kernel of popcorn.

steps.text: Move Birb over a popcorn kernel in the @loc{Meadow}.
Keep gathering popcorn until the lifetime total reaches 10 billion. Increase @mechanic{Popcorn Value} and @mechanic{Faster Popcorn} to improve production.
Collect popcorn, then use Birb’s @mechanic{Rebirb} control to exchange popcorn for Golden Feathers.
After Evolution I, go to the @loc{Bridge} and fish with a rod until you land a catch.
After Evolution III, enter the @loc{Birb Nest}. Chop trees and finish the 100,000-Twig goal for the first Nest upgrade.

achievements.summary: Kill one enemy during an Expedition.

steps.text: Enter an Expedition with the Parrot and attack an enemy on Floor 1.
Buy @mechanic{Unlocks Evolve} after Golden Harvest in the Sunflower tree. The unlock costs 100 million popcorn.
Go to the @loc{Castle} and click the monster to finish the introductory dialogue.
Use @mechanic{HOLD TO FEED} to supply 10 million popcorn, then select @mechanic{EVOLVE}.

guide.context: Evolution clears ordinary fish, Moneta, Twig progress and temporary upgrades. Rods, Fishdex discoveries, Fishing level, Parrot progress, Nest tier and shiny fish remain.

steps.text: Supply 10 billion popcorn and 1,000 Moneta in the Evolution feeding panel, then confirm Evolution 2.

guide.context: Evolution clears ordinary fish, Moneta, Twig progress and temporary upgrades. Rods, Fishdex discoveries, Fishing level, Parrot progress, Nest tier and shiny fish remain.

steps.text: Supply 250 billion popcorn and 30 million Seeds in the Evolution feeding panel, then confirm Evolution 3.

guide.context: Evolution clears ordinary fish, Moneta, Twig progress and temporary upgrades. Rods, Fishdex discoveries, Fishing level, Parrot progress, Nest tier and shiny fish remain.

steps.text: Supply 1Q popcorn, 100,000 Twigs and 10,000 Moneta in the Evolution feeding panel, then confirm Evolution 4.

guide.context: Evolution clears ordinary fish, Moneta, Twig progress and temporary upgrades. Rods, Fishdex discoveries, Fishing level, Parrot progress, Nest tier and shiny fish remain.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Castle} with 1Qi popcorn and 1 million Twigs.
Feed the monster both resources, then select @mechanic{EVOLVE}.

achievements.description: Defeat the first Expedition floor’s boss.
achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 1.

steps.text: Spend SP on the Parrot’s Strength, Vitality and Recovery, then defeat @enemy{Cobra Boss} near the far end of Floor 1.
Defeat the boss on Floor 1, then advance to Expedition Floor 2.
Defeat the boss on Floor 2, then enter the next-floor portal that opens to reach Floor 3.
Reach Evolution V first. Defeat the boss on Floor 3, then enter the next-floor portal that opens to reach Floor 4.
Reach Evolution V first. Defeat the boss on Floor 4, then enter the next-floor portal that opens to reach Floor 5.
Keep gathering popcorn until the lifetime total reaches 10,000. Increase @mechanic{Popcorn Value} and @mechanic{Faster Popcorn} to improve production.
Keep gathering popcorn until the lifetime total reaches 10 million. Increase @mechanic{Popcorn Value} and @mechanic{Faster Popcorn} to improve production.
Defeat @enemy{The Archivist} on Floor 9 and advance the post-boss dialogue.
When the chain-breaking prompt appears, press @mechanic{H} or click its button to free the Castle monster.
After the rescue returns you to the @loc{Castle}, select @mechanic{EVOLVE}. Evolution VI needs no further feeding.
At the @loc{Birb Nest}, harvest trees for Twigs and complete the 1 million-Twig goal for Nest Tier 2.
Reach Evolution V first. Defeat the boss on Floor 5, then enter the next-floor portal that opens to reach Floor 6.
Reach Evolution V first. Defeat the boss on Floor 6, then enter the next-floor portal that opens to reach Floor 7.
Reach Evolution V first. Defeat the boss on Floor 7, then enter the next-floor portal that opens to reach Floor 8.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 2.

steps.text: Fight enemies on Floor 2 for SP. Improve the Parrot’s Strength, Vitality and Recovery, then defeat the floor’s boss.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 3.

steps.text: Fight enemies on Floor 3 for SP. Improve the Parrot’s Strength, Vitality and Recovery, then defeat the floor’s boss.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 5.

steps.text: Fight enemies on Floor 5 for SP. Improve the Parrot’s Strength, Vitality and Recovery, then defeat the floor’s boss.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 6.

steps.text: Fight enemies on Floor 6 for SP. Improve the Parrot’s Strength, Vitality and Recovery, then defeat the floor’s boss.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 7.

steps.text: Fight enemies on Floor 7 for SP. Improve the Parrot’s Strength, Vitality and Recovery, then defeat the floor’s boss.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 8.

steps.text: Fight enemies on Floor 8 for SP. Improve the Parrot’s Strength, Vitality and Recovery, then defeat the floor’s boss.

achievements.description: House your first species in the Aquarium.
achievements.summary: Place one fish species in the Aquarium.

steps.text: After Evolution V, enter the @loc{Aquarium} from the Bridge and donate one owned fish species.

achievements.description: Give an Aquarium species its first shiny upgrade.
achievements.summary: Apply a shiny upgrade to one Aquarium species.

steps.text: Catch a shiny fish, then donate the shiny version to its species in the @loc{Aquarium}.

achievements.description: Unlock the Deep Resonance milestone in the Aquarium.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 250 Aquarium points to unlock Deep Resonance.

steps.text: Donate fish species in the Aquarium until you have 250 points to unlock @mechanic{Deep Resonance}. Donate shiny versions to increase those species’ point values.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 450 Aquarium points to unlock Aquarium Harmony.

steps.text: Donate fish species in the Aquarium until you have 450 points to unlock @mechanic{Aquarium Harmony}. Donate shiny versions to increase those species’ point values.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 700 Aquarium points to unlock Fish Market.

steps.text: Donate fish species in the Aquarium until you have 700 points to unlock @mechanic{Fish Market}. Donate shiny versions to increase those species’ point values.

achievements.description: Open the Mine entrance on Expedition Floor 1.
achievements.summary: Open the Mine entrance on Expedition Floor 1.

steps.text: Check the @mechanic{Mine unlock checklist} at the Floor 1 Mine entrance or in the Parrot Forge. Complete its remaining goals, then open the Mine entrance.
Advance through the Mine to Giant 1. Buy mining upgrades and use charged strikes to improve ore damage.
Break Giant 1 before the Giant Ore challenge timer runs out.
Advance through the Mine to Giant 7. Buy mining upgrades and use charged strikes to improve ore damage.
Break Giant 7 before the Giant Ore challenge timer runs out.
Advance through the Mine to Giant 10. Buy mining upgrades and use charged strikes to improve ore damage.
Break Giant 10 before the Giant Ore challenge timer runs out.

achievements.summary: Perform one Rebirb with the Sparrow.

steps.text: Reach Nest Tier I and use @mechanic{Mitosis} in the Sparrow menu until the flock has 16 Sparrows.
Keep gaining Sparrow XP until Rebirb is available, then select @mechanic{Rebirb} in the Sparrow menu.

achievements.summary: Perform one Rebirb with the Parrot.

steps.text: Reach Evolution IV and Expedition Floor 3. Use the ready button for Parrot Rebirb I, then complete the Parrot’s Rebirb.
Reach Evolution IV and defeat the Floor 2 Witch to obtain a @item{Legendary Key}.
Spend the key on @mechanic{Unlock the Desert Tree} in the Sunflower tree.
Buy @mechanic{Dave} in the Desert tree, then let Dave collect popcorn in the Desert to gain XP.
At level 100, open Dave’s Rebirb panel and choose an instinct for the Rebirb.

achievements.summary: Perform one Rebirb with the Seagull.

steps.text: After Evolution III, let the Seagull fish until level 25. Open the Seagull menu and select @mechanic{Rebirb}.

achievements.summary: Perform one Rebirb with the Crow.

steps.text: Complete Parrot Rebirb II after reaching Floor 6. In the Parrot Forge, raise Punch, Armor and Aura to Epic Level 5.
On Expedition Floor 1, click the Mine entrance’s bars. The Parrot breaks the bars and unlocks the Mine and Crow.
Let the Crow mine ores until level 3, and defeat Giant 1. Claim the free @mechanic{Crow Rebirb} upgrade in the Mine tree.
Open the Crow menu and select @mechanic{REBIRB}.

achievements.summary: Discover every fish species in the Fishdex.

steps.text: Complete Parrot Rebirb I after reaching Evolution IV and Floor 3, then Rebirb II after reaching Floor 6. Defeat The Archivist and complete Parrot Rebirb III to unlock Night Mode.
Choose @mechanic{Night Mode} in the Expedition Hub to enter @loc{Vigil Woods}.
In the @mechanic{Fishdex}, select a missing species. Use its Normal recommendations and fish at its listed habitat with a suitable rod, hook and lure.
Continue until every species has a discovery. Include the Bridge and Vigil Woods fish.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 1 10 times.

steps.text: Defeat the boss on Expedition Floor 1, then stay on that floor and wait for the boss’s respawn countdown. Kill the boss again whenever the countdown ends, until you have 10 victories.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 2 10 times.

steps.text: Defeat the boss on Expedition Floor 2, then stay on that floor and wait for the boss’s respawn countdown. Kill the boss again whenever the countdown ends, until you have 10 victories.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 3 10 times.

steps.text: Defeat the boss on Expedition Floor 3, then stay on that floor and wait for the boss’s respawn countdown. Kill the boss again whenever the countdown ends, until you have 10 victories.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 4 10 times.

steps.text: Defeat the boss on Expedition Floor 4, then stay on that floor and wait for the boss’s respawn countdown. Kill the boss again whenever the countdown ends, until you have 10 victories.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 5 10 times.

steps.text: Defeat the boss on Expedition Floor 5, then stay on that floor and wait for the boss’s respawn countdown. Kill the boss again whenever the countdown ends, until you have 10 victories.

achievements.summary: Upgrade the Nest to Tier III.

steps.text: After Evolution III, finish the 100,000-Twig Nest goal and then the 1 million-Twig goal to reach Nest Tier III.

achievements.description: Cross the bridge in under 3 seconds.
achievements.summary: Traverse the Bridge in less than 3 seconds.

steps.text: Increase @mechanic{Wing Training} and buy @mechanic{Swift Wings} in the Sunflower tree. Run across the @loc{Bridge} in under 3 seconds.

achievements.summary: Defeat Tutu Shark on Expedition Floor 4.

steps.text: On Expedition Floor 4, improve the Parrot with SP and defeat @enemy{Tutu Shark}.

achievements.description: Have 3 shiny buffs active at the same time.
achievements.summary: Keep three shiny fish buffs active simultaneously.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Extra Stomach} in the fishing upgrade tree. Earn 10 Aquarium points from donations to unlock @mechanic{Extra Course} and the third buff slot.
In Collection, eat shiny fish from three different species so their buffs are active together.
Reach Evolution IV and defeat the Floor 2 Witch to obtain a @item{Legendary Key}.
Spend the key on @mechanic{Unlock the Desert Tree} in the Sunflower tree.
Buy @mechanic{Desert Core}, then gather Golden Popcorn in the Desert until the total reaches 1 million.
At Evolution V or later, defeat the Floor 8 boss and enter the next-floor portal to Floor 9.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss of Expedition Floor 9.

steps.text: At Evolution V and 600 Aquarium Resonance, unlock @mechanic{Lineage Lake}. Pay 1 million Twigs for Nest breeding, breed two @item{Crownfrost Serpents} together and activate the damage hybrid.
Equip two @item{Skulls}, one @item{Depth Chronicle} and two @item{Spirit Amulets}. Infuse the Skulls and Spirit Amulets as far as you can afford.
Activate @item{Throne of Winter}, @item{Crownfrost Serpent} and @item{Coldsnap Runner} fish buffs for damage and attack speed.
Put SP into Strength. About 650Sx SP and 123Oc damage after buffs are the reference setup for this burst method.
Turn off Auto attack. Hold the reroll control beside the Expedition leave button until you can approach @enemy{The Archivist} safely and its health is near 837Oc.
Click The Archivist rapidly to accelerate Parrot attacks. Retry after death if the burst fails.

achievements.summary: Consume a legendary fish that provides a popcorn buff.

steps.text: Select a legendary fish with a Popcorn bonus in the @mechanic{Collection} tab, then eat that fish.

achievements.summary: Discover the shiny form of every fish species.

steps.text: Complete Parrot Rebirb I after reaching Evolution IV and Floor 3, then Rebirb II after reaching Floor 6. Defeat The Archivist and complete Parrot Rebirb III to unlock Night Mode.
Choose @mechanic{Night Mode} in the Expedition Hub to enter @loc{Vigil Woods}.
In the @mechanic{Fishdex}, select a missing shiny species. Use its Shiny recommendations and fish at its listed habitat with a suitable rod, hook and lure.
Continue until every species has a shiny discovery. Include the Bridge and Vigil Woods fish.
Finish @mechanic{Nest Tier II}, then enter the @loc{Expedition Hub}.

achievements.summary: Accumulate 4 hours and 20 minutes of playtime.

steps.text: Keep playing until Birb’s recorded playtime reaches 4 hours and 20 minutes.
Keep the Parrot fighting Expedition enemies until the kill count reaches 100,000.
Earn 100 Golden Feathers through Birb Rebirbs, then buy @mechanic{Sunflower Vending} at the @loc{Sunflower Field}.

achievements.summary: Hold a balance of 1 billion popcorn.

steps.text: Let the popcorn balance reach 1 billion before buying another upgrade or performing a Rebirb.
After buying Sunflower Vending, stand in the Sunflower Field’s flowerbed to collect Seeds. Buy Popcorn Silo for 50 Seeds and Auto Generator for 500 Seeds, then keep generating Seeds toward 1 billion.
Let Dave collect Desert popcorn to gain XP. Each time Dave has 100 levels available, perform a Rebirb and assign an instinct until the Rebirb counter reaches 100.
Keep the Seagull fishing and perform Rebirbs until the count reaches 100. Each Rebirb uses 25 levels initially and 50 levels after the tenth Rebirb.

achievements.displayName: Deal with It (Be a Cool Birb)
achievements.description: Send a message in chat. Unlocks the Deal with It sunglasses.
achievements.summary: Post one message in the in-game chat.

steps.text: Connect to the in-game chat and send one message.

achievements.description: Reach Mine area 100 and break 100 legendary ores across Evolutions. Unlocks the Geode Helmet.
achievements.summary: Reach Mine area 100 and break 100 legendary ores across Evolutions.

steps.text: Reach area 100 of the Mine.
Break legendary ores until the cumulative count reaches 100. Manual mining and the Crow both contribute.

achievements.description: Click 50 bats in the Mine. Unlocks the Bat Hat.

steps.text: While mining, click bats until the Bat Hat counter reaches 50.
